messages:
Maria L: Quick Q4 sync — compact status for core infra milestones. TL;DR: shipped -> routing-table v2 canary; slipped -> autoscale heuristics tweak; next -> finalize PRs, handoff docs. Pinging owners below for async updates. @Ravi (PM) for priority guidance.

Devin K: Thanks — PR #5427 (autoscale refactor) is in review, awaiting 2nd approval. I can take the heuristic patch if we bump priority. ETA EOD Tue to open a patch PR if nothing blocks.

AJ: Canary deployed routing-v2 to dedicated-us-west pool this morning. Quick smoke: p50 18ms, p95 85ms, p99 ~120ms. Meets SLO in that region so far.
```
# smoke/check
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-1","prompt":"ping"}' | jq -r '.latency_ms'
```

Sasha N: FYI privacy/compliance review flagged audit-logging gaps for Private deploys. Need a schema + retention policy. Who owns this? @Lewis P?

Lewis P: I can take audit logs. Plan: add schema + retention flag by Fri. Blocker: legal needs retention duration — pinged them.

Ravi (PM): Legal asked for 90d retention as default. Also prioritization note: autoscale heuristic patch gets top priority if it reduces unit cost by >15%.

ci-bot: CI green for #5427, e2e staging passed, coverage +1%. Staging deploy scheduled Thu 03:00 UTC.

Devin K: One technical blocker: sim harness flaky test (timeout) is preventing stable CI on the heuristic branch. Short-term: I'll add a retry and mark test flaky, and open a follow-up ticket to root-cause.

AJ: Heads-up — saw a small batching latency regression after the routing change in the canary run. Running a prerelease job to confirm; if confirmed that may nudge autoscale patch schedule by a day.

Maria L: Noted — add that to the risk board. Current plan: (1) Devin: autoscale patch -> staging Wed -> canary Thu; (2) AJ: finish routing rollback + validation steps; (3) Lewis: audit logs PR by Fri; (4) Ravi: confirm prioritization if cost savings estimate >15%. If anything blocks, drop updates here.

Devin K: Will post PR link and short checklist once retry + flaky marker are in.

Lewis P: Will draft retention schema and open PR for review today. Need one review from security.

Ravi (PM): Confirming autoscale patch priority. If cost reduction estimate holds, we push it ahead of minor UX backlog.

AJ: Posted prerelease job logs to the ticket — looks like one outlier host caused the spike. Investigating network/driver.

Maria L: Great. I'll update the Q4 milestone doc and add owners/CTS. Also tagging analytics to monitor per-token cost changes during canary. :rocket:

Devin K: Quick ask — can someone review #5427 today? Need one more approval to merge.

Lewis P: I'll take an approval pass after lunch.

AJ: I can do a quick CR for routing-related bits.

Maria L: Awesome. If merged, schedule a brief rollback runbook in the PR. Otherwise we risk noisy failures during traffic spike.

Ravi (PM): Thanks all — please post final ship notes here when done.

Maria L: :thumbsup:
